title: Protocol Extensions: Default Behaviour
hints: A protocol extension can supply default implementations.
Provide the default `greet()` and a `greetTwice()` in the extension; `Pirate` implements its own `greet()`.
`func greetTwice() -> String { greet() + " " + greet() }` in `extension Greeter`.
jsBridge: Protocol extensions provide default method implementations, like mixins or TS abstract-class defaults, but applicable to structs and enums. Conforming types get the behaviour free and can override it.
